query: Current fill percentage/storage of Lázaro Cárdenas (El Palmito) dam in Durango Mexico from Conagua SINA, latest daily readings for July 2026 and late June 2026
answer:
I've completed the research on the Lázaro Cárdenas (El Palmito) dam storage levels. Here's the key summary:

## El Palmito Dam — June–July 2026 (Conagua/SINA)

**Latest daily readings (declining trajectory):**
| Date | % of capacity | Volume |
|------|--------------|--------|
| **Jul 16, 2026** (most recent) | ~19% | ~598 Mm³ |
| Jul 13, 2026 | 20.5% | — |
| Jul 8, 2026 | 21% | — |
| **Jun 19, 2026** (late-June anchor) | 25.87% | 765 Mm³ |
| Jun 1, 2026 (unverified) | 31.0% | 915.9 Mm³ |

**Key findings:**
- The reservoir was in **drawdown, not filling** — extractions (~109 m³/s, ~7 Mm³/day) for the 2026 agricultural cycle exceeded weak rain-driven inflows.
- The 2026 cycle commitment was **750 Mm³**; gates were expected to close in the last week of July 2026.
- Officials called it a historically low level, threatening the **2027** agricultural cycle absent stronger rains.
- Implied full (NAMO) capacity is **~2,950–3,000 Mm³**.

**Caveats:** The June 1 figure (31%) came from a single source I couldn't cross-validate, so it carries lower confidence, though it fits the overall downward path. The SINA live portal requires JavaScript and couldn't be scraped directly, so all figures come from Conagua reports relayed via Mexican regional media. Most reliable latest reading: **July 16, 2026 (~19%, ~598 Mm³)**.
